status: source-frozen candidate equations; numerical qualification required before holdout assessment

source.title: An explanation of the turbulent round-jet/plane-jet anomaly
source.author: S. B. Pope

model: Steady incompressible high-Re axisymmetric boundary-layer k-epsilon similarity with radial turbulent diffusion, shear production, and signed Pope vortex-stretching correction. Molecular viscosity, axial turbulent diffusion and axial normal-stress gradients are omitted. No turbulent Schmidt number or droplet model is inferred.
normalization: eta=r/(x-x0), U=A F/(x-x0), F(0)=1; no measured width or entrainment coefficient imposed

required: independent analytic and tensor equation checks
qualification.note: These are numerical/source-reproduction checks, not experimental uncertainty intervals. Unqualified solutions cannot be assessed as physical predictions. Numerical initialization may be improved without changing these coefficients or consulting holdout errors.

holdout: Unchanged Hussein 1994 reference.json, 20% gate. Assess only after numerical qualification; do not fit coefficients or normalization to it.
energy_ownership: RANS k represents total modeled turbulence. It cannot be assigned to unresolved LES energy without a separate filter/ownership model.
